BERLIN, 16 juillet 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: BERLIN, July 16, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Several agreements and memorandums of understanding were signed during the Algerian-German Economic Forum, covering key sectors such as energy, pharmaceuticals, transport and industrial technologies. The documents focus on concrete partnerships, know-how transfers and bilateral investments.
Le Forum économique algéro-allemand, qui: The Algerian-German Economic Forum, which was held on Friday in Berlin, allowed the signing of several agreements and memorandums of understanding between companies and institutions of the two countries. These documents cover strategic sectors such as energy, pharmaceuticals, transport and industrial technologies, with the aim of strengthening bilateral cooperation.
Dans le domaine de l'énergie, un mémoran: In the field of energy, a memorandum between Sonatrach and the German company VNG was signed. This text commits the parties to open negotiations with a view to renewing the gas export contract and increasing exported volumes. Furthermore, two commercial agreements were concluded between EXWOR and German companies (Field Equipment and Services, PSE Engineering GmbH) for the supply of equipment and technologies intended for the Algerian and African oil fields.
Le secteur pharmaceutique a également ét: The pharmaceutical sector was also highlighted with the signing of a memorandum between Saidal and Boehringer Ingelheim. This partnership provides for the local manufacturing of four strategic pharmaceutical molecules (diabetes, heart failure, kidney diseases) and the development of an industrial partnership in research and development. Another agreement was signed between VET AGRI PHARMA and EQUINEXT SOLUTIONS Deutschland for the creation of a veterinary medicine production unit in Algeria.
Cinq mémorandums d'entente ont été signé: Five memorandums of understanding were signed between Siemens Mobility and two Algerian companies: SNTF and the Algiers Metro Operating Company (EMA). These agreements aim to strengthen cooperation in rail transport, the development of urban transport solutions and the transfer of technologies and know-how. A partnership has also been formalized between OPEN DISK and EQUINEXT SOLUTIONS Deutschland to support industrial investors thanks to a combination of German expertise and local know-how.
Dans le domaine des tabacs, deux accords: In the tobacco sector, two agreements were signed by Madar Holding with German companies (Korber Technologies GmbH, FOCKE & CO. GmbH & Co.KG). The first concerns the protection of confidential information within the framework of the Algerian Tobacco Company project, while the second concerns the assessment of packaging equipment needs and the exploration of industrial and commercial cooperation.
Enfin, un accord commercial a été signé: Finally, a commercial agreement was signed between International Company Renewable Solar SARL and RCT Solutions for the carrying out of engineering studies and the supervision of the construction of a silicon metal production plant, intended for the metallurgical industries and solar energy. Another partnership was announced between the Boussouf Fatah group and Fleming Hotels for the management and granting of a hotel franchise.
